owned_invariants: Every run record names the exact bytes it ran against.
boundaries: Runs the operator's command without a shell.

score.level_basis: Tool-execution receipts (SCORING.md section 6): command, versions, times, exit status, report hash and the hash of every governed input; timeouts and unstartable commands are recorded, not raised.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None and a unique contract URN; the exported names (__all__ or public types) are the ones the docstring describes and the contract lists. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Non-Numeric profile: inputs are admitted by strict Pydantic models before use (RULE_PY_001) and outputs are typed; behaviour matches the documented contract in the module docstring and README. Not B: tool versions are read from installed distribution metadata only.
basis.G3: Every expected failure is a typed exception with a stable code (AdmissionError, BudgetExceededError, UnknownPackError) or a typed verdict; no assert in production code (Ruff S101, AST test) and the whole suite passes under python -O; no bare or broad except (Ruff BLE001/E722). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit and boundary tests for every branch, negative tests for each refusal, run under pytest and under python -O. Exit status, timeout, unstartable command, name refusals and log normalisation are tested. Mutation R = 1/1 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Functions are single-purpose; complexity measured per function. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 8, cognitive 6, nesting 2; metrics ceiling A+.
